svg.title: 并行研究、反馈与引用整理 workflow diagram
svg.desc: {"steps":[{"id":"plan","name":"保存研究计划","actor":"lead","type":"action"},{"id":"research","name":"动态并行研究","actor":"researchers","type":"subprocess"},{"id":"synthesize","name":"汇总并判断","actor":"lead","type":"decision"},{"id":"cite","name":"定位引用来源","actor":"citations","type":"action"},{"id":"answer","name":"接收研究结果","actor":"user","type":"outcome"}],"edges":[{"id":"e1","from":"plan","to":"research","kind":"sequence"},{"id":"e2","from":"research","to":"synthesize","kind":"sequence"},{"id":"e3","from":"synthesize","to":"research","kind":"feedback","condition":"more research"},{"id":"e4","from":"synthesize","to":"cite","kind":"conditional","condition":"sufficient information"},{"id":"e5","from":"cite","to":"answer","kind":"sequence"}],"coverage":{"mode":"documented_narrative_overview","unknowns":["动态研究子 Agent 的实际数量、各轮工具顺序与执行时长未知。","更多研究和停止的具体判断规则未公开。","中断、失败和引用无法定位时的完整处理未知。","此库未执行该系统，也未独立核验原文的效果数字。"],"inferences":["动态子 Agent 与内部搜索迭代合并为并行集合节点。"]}}
